items.title: Herb Ellis interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I had it with Sweets Edison, he’s here at the festival, you know.

ctx.x: Can you tell us other musicians that you’ve had that chemistry with?

Oh let me see. Well there’s a lot of them. I had it with Sweets Edison, he’s here at the festival, you know. And I have it with Jake Hanna, the drummer. And of course I have it with Ray Brown to a great extent. We love to play together. So there could be more but I can’t name them all.
Could you also explain to guitarists how that it takes an impeccable sense of time to play in a trio with no drums.

items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: But Herb Ellis, he didn't make those tours with us.

ctx.x: You see, he was playing for Ella. And we had -- the next time I went out was -- it was Louie Bellson, practically the same ones, you know, practically the same ones. But Herb Ellis, he didn't make those tours with us. But that was a fantastic time, real great. I think Norman puts on the finest sessions that can be put on, I really do.
Well, he has a very good idea of --
